content.title: Reading: Incomplete Sentences
content.scenario_summary: Thirty independent workplace and everyday business sentences covering inspection, trade fairs, catering, maintenance, markets, subscriptions, training, travel, design, customer service, and publishing.

questions.prompt: Any machine that fails the safety inspection must {{q1}} before production resumes.

explanation.summary_zh: 機器需要接受維修，因此使用 must be repaired。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主詞是未通過安檢的機器，維修是施加在機器上的動作；must 後用 be 加過去分詞，表達必須接受維修。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: repair 是主動原形，會把機器寫成進行維修的一方，不符合此處受修理的意思。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: be repaired 與 must 組成情態被動式，表示機器必須修好才能恢復生產。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: have repaired 為主動完成式，此句沒有交代機器修理了什麼，也不表達接受維修。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: be repairing 是主動進行式，表示正在修理，與機器接受維修的角色不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷動作與主詞的關係；情態動詞後的被動結構為 be 加過去分詞。

questions.prompt: Among the twelve exhibition halls at the trade fair, Hall C is by far the {{q2}} to reach from the station.

explanation.summary_zh: 十二座展館構成比較範圍，應選最高級 most convenient。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Among the twelve exhibition halls 設定整組比較對象，by far 加強最高級的差距；此處評比哪座展館從車站前往最方便。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: convenient 是原級，無法在此 the 與 to reach 之間構成本句的整組比較。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: more convenient 是比較級；此句是在十二座展館中選出最方便的一座，沒有設定兩者比較。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: conveniently 是副詞，此處要用形容詞描述 Hall C 前往是否方便。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: most convenient 為最高級形容詞，符合十二座展館中最方便的比較。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找比較範圍，再判斷比較級或最高級；by far 可用來強調最高級的差距。

questions.prompt: In {{q3}} for a large catering order, the restaurant has reserved extra refrigerator space.

explanation.summary_zh: In preparation for 表示為某件事預作準備。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 介系詞 in 後的 preparation 是名詞，與 for a large catering order 組成「為大型外燴訂單作準備」的片語。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: preparation 為名詞，in preparation for 符合預留冷藏空間的目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: prepare 是動詞原形，不能在此直接作 in 的名詞補語。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: preparatory 是形容詞，後面沒有可供修飾的名詞，無法構成本句片語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: prepared 是形容詞或過去分詞，不能填入此處需要名詞的 preparation for 結構。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到介系詞片語，要確認空格所需詞類及後接補語的組合。

questions.prompt: To prevent falls on the wet entrance steps, building maintenance staff will apply a {{q4}} coating.

explanation.summary_zh: 防止濕階梯上跌倒，需要 nonslip「防滑的」塗層。
explanation.reasoning_zh: To prevent falls 明確指出需求，而 wet entrance steps 說明使用環境；四種塗層性質中，防滑直接對應避免滑倒。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: decorative 表示裝飾用的，描述外觀用途，沒有防滑的意思。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: transparent 表示透明的，描述透光性，無法對應避免滑倒的需求。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: nonslip 表示防滑的，符合在潮濕階梯上防止跌倒的用途。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: reflective 表示反光的，涉及反射光線，不表示表面能防滑。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 功能性形容詞題可由具體用途鎖定所需性質，避免只看物品名稱。

questions.prompt: Market vendors must finish unloading {{q5}} shoppers enter at nine, so delivery vehicles and customers never share the narrow aisle.

explanation.summary_zh: 為避免車輛與顧客共用通道，卸貨必須在顧客入場前完成。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後半句明確要求送貨車輛與顧客不在狹窄通道同時出現，因此卸貨結束要早於九點顧客入場，應用 before。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: before 建立先卸完貨、後讓顧客入場的順序，符合通道分流的目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: while 表示顧客入場時仍在完成卸貨，不能建立所需的先後分隔。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: until 表示持續到某時為止，但 finish unloading 是完成的界點，這裡不能用 until 表達入場前必須卸完。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: once 表示顧客一入場便完成卸貨，把完成動作放在入場之後，與分流目的不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 時間連接詞要配合事件順序；目的或結果子句常能確定哪件事必須先完成。

questions.prompt: The bakery asks wholesale customers to place their {{q6}} for sandwich rolls at least two days before delivery.

explanation.summary_zh: place an order 是下訂單，符合要求客戶提前訂購的情境。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 客戶要在配送前兩天下單訂購麵包；place their orders for 指「下訂購某商品的訂單」，其餘名詞不構成此處的下單搭配。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: shipments 指運送的貨物或貨批，place shipments for 不表示客戶下單訂購。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: orders 指訂單，place orders for sandwich rolls 表示訂購三明治麵包。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: supplies 指物資，place supplies for 不構成此處「訂購」的搭配。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: inventories 指存貨或存貨清單，不能與 place 搭配表達此處的下單動作。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 訂購商品可用 place an order for；動詞與名詞要連同商品補語一起判讀。

questions.prompt: The basic software subscription allows five simultaneous {{q7}}, so the sixth employee must wait for someone to sign out.

explanation.summary_zh: 第六名員工必須等人登出，表示方案只允許五名使用者同時使用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: sign out 與 sixth employee 指向登入人數限制；five simultaneous users 表示同時使用軟體的五名使用者。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: upgrades 是升級，升級次數不能解釋第六名員工要等別人登出的限制。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: invoices 是帳單／發票，帳單數量與同時登入的員工人數不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: users 是使用者，能與第六名員工及登出空缺的因果關係相接。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: backups 是備份，備份數量不是這裡由員工登出而釋出的名額。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 名詞辨義要追蹤後文的動作與角色；sign out 可提示系統使用者。

questions.prompt: The volunteer program secured extra funding {{q8}} its community projects having attracted national attention.

explanation.summary_zh: having attracted 不是限定動詞，整段原因宜接在 owing to 後。
explanation.reasoning_zh: its community projects having attracted national attention 是非限定分詞子句，表達計畫受到全國關注這件事；owing to 可接此成分。其餘三項在這裡需要含限定動詞的原因子句。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: because 在此需接完整的限定子句，例如 its community projects had attracted attention；現有的 having attracted 不提供限定動詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: now that 後可接說明既成情況的限定子句，但本句使用 having attracted，並非 have 或 had attracted。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: in that 可引出說明原因的限定子句；現有成分缺少這種子句所需的限定動詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: owing to 可以非限定分詞子句作補語，表示因社區計畫已受到全國關注而獲得額外經費。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 原因連接語的選擇須檢查整個補語；名詞後接 having 加過去分詞，並不因此成為限定子句。

questions.prompt: The advanced training session lasts thirty minutes {{q9}} than the introductory workshop.

explanation.summary_zh: than 比較兩場課程的時間，應選 longer。
explanation.reasoning_zh: thirty minutes 說明兩場課程的時間差，than 引出比較對象；longer 表示進階課程比入門工作坊多三十分鐘。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: longest 是最高級，不符合此處由 than 引出的兩者比較。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: longer 是比較級，可與 thirty minutes 及 than 搭配表示較長多少時間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: length 是名詞，不能在 lasts thirty minutes 後構成此處的程度比較。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: long 是原級，沒有配合 than 表示兩者長度差異。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 比較級前可放時間或距離差額，例如 thirty minutes longer than。

questions.prompt: To appear in the association’s next directory, members must submit address changes {{q10}} May 12, when editing closes.

explanation.summary_zh: May 12 是收件截止點，應用 by 表示最遲期限。
explanation.reasoning_zh: when editing closes 指出五月十二日編輯作業截止；要在下一期名錄列入地址變更，會員必須不晚於當日提交。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: since 表示從某個起點延續至後來，不表達提交變更的最後期限。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: within 可接一段時間表示在該期間內；May 12 是日期，不是這種時間長度補語。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: for 可表示持續多久，但此處是日期而非提交動作的持續時間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: by 表示不晚於指定時間，符合編輯截止前必須提交的要求。

explanation.takeaway_zh: by 加時間可表示期限；辨別事件是要在某時之前完成，還是持續一段時間。

questions.prompt: The proposed conference venue seats all 300 delegates; {{q11}}, its meeting rooms have built-in projectors.

explanation.summary_zh: 後半句補充另一項場地優點，應用 moreover。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 可容納全部代表與會議室內建投影機是並列支持該場地的兩個特點；分號後的 moreover 表示追加資訊。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: moreover 表示「此外」，自然補充另一項支持選用此場地的特點。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: otherwise 表示「否則」或其他情況，此處沒有提出未滿足條件會造成的結果。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: instead 表示替代，內建投影機並不是取代容納三百人的安排。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: nevertheless 表示轉折讓步，但有投影機並未違反場地可容納所有人的預期。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 連接副詞要反映兩個命題的關係；補充並列支持點可用 moreover。

questions.prompt: With {{q12}} seats still available on the evening train, the booking agent could offer our group only three.

explanation.summary_zh: 僅能提供三個座位，應選 few 表示剩餘座位不多。
explanation.reasoning_zh: seats 是複數可數名詞，many 與 few 都能修飾；但 only three 顯示可提供的座位數量不足，符合 few。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: much 用於不可數數量，不能在此修飾複數 seats。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: many 指很多座位，與只剩少量可提供、僅能給三個的語意不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: few 修飾複數可數名詞，表示座位所剩不多，符合 only three。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: little 用於不可數數量，不能在此修飾複數 seats。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 數量詞先看可數性，再看上下文要求多或少；可數性不一定足以決定答案。

questions.prompt: The concierge was particularly {{q13}} of a guest’s limited mobility when planning the walking tour.

explanation.summary_zh: considerate of 表示體諒，符合禮賓人員顧及客人行動限制的情境。
explanation.reasoning_zh: was 後需要描述 concierge 的補語；considerate 與 considerable 都是形容詞，但 considerate of 表示體諒某人的處境，considerable 則表示數量或程度相當大。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: consideration 是名詞「考量／體貼」，此處 was particularly consideration of 不能描述禮賓人員的體貼態度。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: considerately 是副詞，不能在此單獨作 was 後描述 concierge 的狀態補語。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: considerable 是形容詞「相當大的」，不表示體諒他人的行動限制，也不構成本句所需的 considerate of 搭配。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: considerate 是形容詞，considerate of a guest’s limited mobility 表示安排步行行程時顧及客人的行動限制。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 詞形題有時需先判斷補語詞類，再區分同字族的不同形容詞意思，如 considerate 與 considerable。

questions.prompt: The local newspaper now runs a weekly column on {{q14}} issues such as inflation and unemployment.

explanation.summary_zh: 通膨與失業是經濟議題，應用 economic 修飾 issues。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格修飾名詞 issues；economic 與 economical 都是形容詞，但 economic 指與經濟有關，economical 指節省資源。後面的通膨與失業明確界定前者。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: economically 是副詞，不能在此直接修飾 issues 作所需的前置形容詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: economic 表示與經濟有關，符合通膨與失業這兩個議題例子。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: economize 是動詞「節省」，不能在此充當修飾 issues 的形容詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: economical 表示省錢或節省資源；這裡在說通膨與失業等經濟議題，不是描述某項安排節省資源。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨認形容詞位置後仍須檢查字義；economic 指經濟相關，economical 指節省資源。

questions.prompt: For accurate product photographs, the light source must be {{q15}} consistent throughout the session.

explanation.summary_zh: perfectly 修飾 consistent，表示光源十分穩定一致。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格修飾 be 後的形容詞 consistent，說明整場拍攝的一致程度；後面沒有名詞可讓 perfect 另作前置修飾，因此用副詞 perfectly。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: perfectly 為副詞，可修飾 consistent，表達一致性達到完全穩定的程度。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: perfection 為名詞「完美」，不能在此修飾形容詞 consistent。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: perfect 是形容詞；本句要用 consistent 描述光源，再用空格說明其程度，be perfect consistent 不能構成這個補語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: perfecting 是動詞分詞，表示使某事更完善，不構成此處的形容詞程度修飾。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 副詞可修飾形容詞；找出實際被修飾的成分，不要只看附近是否有名詞。

questions.prompt: The award recognizes the partnership through {{q16}} two local companies developed a reusable shipping container.

explanation.summary_zh: through 後的 which 指回 partnership，組成關係子句。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 先行詞是 the partnership；through which 表示「透過這項合作」，其中 which 作前置介系詞 through 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 指人且不是本句 partnership 所需的關係代名詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: what 可用於融合關係結構，但此處已有先行詞 partnership，不使用 through what 來修飾它。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 指回 partnership，作 through 的受詞，連接合作與開發容器的關係。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所有關係；若把 whose two local companies 整體作 through 的受詞，developed 就缺少子句主詞。此處 two local companies 應作主詞，through 的受詞是指回 partnership 的 which。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 介系詞前置的關係子句要同時檢查先行詞及介系詞受詞，如 through which。

questions.prompt: The schedule for collections from the apartment buildings {{q17}} unchanged despite the addition of several recycling stops.

explanation.summary_zh: 主詞中心詞是單數 schedule，故用 remains。
explanation.reasoning_zh: for collections from the apartment buildings 是修飾 schedule 的介系詞片語；不能讓其中的複數 buildings 決定主要動詞的形式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: remain 的現在式形式不與本句第三人稱單數主詞 schedule 配合。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: have remained 的助動詞 have 不與本句第三人稱單數主詞配合，若用完成式應為 has remained。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: remaining 為分詞，單獨使用無法提供本句所需的限定動詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: remains 為第三人稱單數現在式，與 schedule 一致，表示時程維持不變。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主詞與動詞之間有修飾語時，回到主詞中心詞判斷一致關係。

questions.prompt: Before choosing plants, the landscape designer will {{q18}} a site visit to assess shade and soil conditions.

explanation.summary_zh: conduct a site visit 表示進行現場勘查。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 設計師要透過現場勘查評估遮蔭與土壤，因此此處需要能與 a site visit 搭配、表示執行勘查的 conduct。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: conduct 表示進行或執行，可搭配 a site visit，符合現場評估的動作。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: produce 指製作或產出，通常產出報告等成果，不能在此表達進行現場勘查。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: install 指安裝設備等，不與 a site visit 搭配表示勘查。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: compose 指撰寫或創作作品，不與 a site visit 搭配表示執行訪查。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 動詞搭配題須辨識受詞是活動還是成果；conduct 可用於執行某項調查活動。

questions.prompt: Passengers were {{q19}} to learn that the airport shuttle fare included door-to-door service.

explanation.summary_zh: 乘客是感到驚訝的人，應選 surprised。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Passengers 是得知接送服務後產生感受的經驗者；were surprised to learn 描述他們驚訝的狀態。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: surprising 形容令人驚訝的事物或人，會把乘客寫成引起驚訝的一方，而非得知消息後驚訝。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: surprised 描述感到驚訝的狀態，符合乘客得知車資含到府接送服務的情境。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: surprise 是名詞或動詞原形，不能在 were 後構成本句所需的狀態補語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: surprisingly 是副詞，不能單獨接在 were 後描述乘客的狀態。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 情緒分詞要區分感受者與引發感受者：surprised 是感到驚訝，surprising 是令人驚訝。

questions.prompt: The stage crew will {{q20}} the temporary platform so its panels can be stacked flat in the delivery van.

explanation.summary_zh: 要將平台拆成可平放堆疊的板件，應用 take apart。
explanation.reasoning_zh: so 子句交代作業目的：把平台的板件平放堆在送貨車內。take apart 表示拆開組裝物，能讓板件分離，符合這項運送準備。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: set aside 表示放到一旁或保留，不表示將平台拆成個別板件，無法表達這裡為平放堆疊所需的拆解動作。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: put together 表示組裝，會把板件組成平台，與準備將個別板件平放堆疊的方向相反。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: take apart 表示拆開，將組裝的平台分成板件後，便能平放堆在車內，符合目的子句。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: bring back 表示帶回某處，描述位置移動，不表達此處將平台拆成板件以便堆疊的作業。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 片語動詞題可由作業的預期結果判斷動作；take apart 表示拆開，put together 表示組裝。

questions.prompt: Readers who need help renewing library cards can ask a librarian to guide {{q21}} through the online form.

explanation.summary_zh: them 指需要協助的讀者，作 guide 的受詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Readers 是接受填表引導的人；ask a librarian to guide 後需要表示這群讀者的受格代名詞，因此用 them。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: their 是所有格限定詞，後面需有相應名詞，不能在此單獨指讀者作受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: theirs 表示「他們的某物」，在此沒有可回指的所屬物，也不指接受引導的讀者本人。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: they 是主格，不能在此作 guide 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是受格複數代名詞，回指 Readers，表示館員引導這些讀者填表。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 代名詞題同時看語法角色及指涉；所有格代名詞即使能作受詞，也未必符合要指的人事物。

questions.prompt: During the initial {{q22}}, the architect will ask about your needs before developing any drawings or cost estimates.

explanation.summary_zh: 建築師先了解需求的會談是 consultation。
explanation.reasoning_zh: ask about your needs 描述先諮詢、了解客戶需求的過程，而且發生在繪圖及估價之前；consultation 最符合此階段。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: consultation 指諮詢會談，符合建築師先詢問客戶需求的活動。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: blueprint 指藍圖，是設計成果而非詢問需求的會談；本句也說尚未繪圖。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: invoice 指帳單／發票，是請款文件，不是此處先了解需求的過程。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: completion 指完成，與 initial 及尚未開始繪圖估價的階段不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨別流程名詞與成果名詞，可利用「做了什麼」以及事情先後定位。

questions.prompt: The company offers two dental plans: one covers routine care only, while {{q23}} also includes major procedures.

explanation.summary_zh: 兩項方案中已介紹一項，the other 指剩下的另一項。
explanation.reasoning_zh: two dental plans 設定兩項方案的範圍，one 先介紹其中一項；後半句以 the other 作單數主詞，指另一項方案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: others 是複數代名詞，與兩者中只剩一項及後面的 includes 不相符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: other 在此沒有名詞或限定詞，不能單獨作指稱另一項方案的單數主詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: the other 可單獨指已知兩者中剩下的一項，與 includes 配合。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: each other 是互相的意思，不能在此作介紹第二項方案的主詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 在明確的兩者範圍中，one ... the other 可區分其中一個與剩下的一個。

questions.prompt: To avoid tearing the delicate microphone cover, pull it off {{q24}} rather than with a sharp tug.

explanation.summary_zh: 要避免撕裂易損的麥克風套，應輕柔地拉下。
explanation.reasoning_zh: delicate、avoid tearing 與 rather than with a sharp tug 共同限定動作方式；gently 表示輕柔，不使用猛力拉扯。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: forcefully 表示用力地，與避免以猛力拉扯而撕裂的要求相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: gently 表示輕柔地，符合小心取下易損麥克風套的方式。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: abruptly 表示突然、猛然地，不符合與 sharp tug 對比的柔和拉取方式。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: roughly 表示粗魯或粗暴地，與保護易損麥克風套的要求不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 方式副詞題可比較動作如何進行；注意 rather than 等明確的對照線索。

questions.prompt: Survey respondents were {{q25}} with the delivery service but requested a wider choice of time slots.

explanation.summary_zh: satisfied with 表示對配送服務感到滿意。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後是 with the delivery service，需選能自然接此補語的形容詞；satisfied with 表示滿意，後句再提出改善時段選擇的要求。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: enthusiastic 表示熱衷或熱情，描述對某服務的態度時通常接 about，而不是此處的 with。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: grateful 表示感激；對某項服務感激可用 grateful for，感謝某人可用 grateful to，不用本句的 with。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: eager 表示渴望，常接 to 加動詞或 for 加所求事物，不能在此接 with 表示滿意。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: satisfied 可接 with 加滿意的對象，符合對配送服務的評價。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 形容詞補語搭配須整組學習，例如 satisfied with、grateful for 及 eager to。

questions.prompt: The packaging designer will {{q26}} a matte finish to the client because it reduces glare under store lighting.

explanation.summary_zh: 設計師基於減少反光的優點向客戶推薦霧面處理。
explanation.reasoning_zh: recommend something to someone 表示向某人推薦某物；because 子句提供霧面處理的好處，符合提出建議的情境。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: recommend 可接 a matte finish to the client，表示向客戶推薦這種表面處理。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: request 表示請求；此處 request a matte finish to the client 不符合向某人請求某物的補語結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: acknowledge 表示承認或確認收到；a matte finish 不是此處要承認的事實或確認收到的訊息。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: remind 表示提醒，通常先接被提醒的人；此處 a matte finish 不是被提醒的對象。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 溝通動詞要同時看意圖和補語結構；recommend something to someone 可表示向某人推薦。

questions.prompt: Our print shop stocks three recycled papers, and you may choose {{q27}} best suits your brochure.

explanation.summary_zh: whichever 表示三種紙材中任何最適合的一種，並引出 choose 的受詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: whichever best suits your brochure 整體作 choose 的受詞；whichever 本身也在子句內作 suits 的主詞，表示可自由選用其中一種。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whoever 指符合條件的任何人，但本句要從三種紙材中選物品，指涉不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: that 在此若作連接詞，後面的 best suits 缺少主詞；若作關係代名詞則缺少先行詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: whichever 將「任何適合的一種」與關係子句融合，整體可作 choose 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所有關係，此處沒有被擁有的名詞，也無法表達選擇紙材。

explanation.takeaway_zh: whichever 可在限定選項中表示任何一個，並把所指事物與其條件整合成名詞性子句。

questions.prompt: When I called the rental depot at noon yesterday, the technician {{q28}} our generator and had not yet finished.

explanation.summary_zh: 昨天中午通話時測試尚未完成，使用過去進行式 was testing。
explanation.reasoning_zh: at noon yesterday 建立過去時間點，had not yet finished 說明當時測試仍在進行；was testing 描述該時刻尚未完成的活動。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: is testing 為現在進行式，與昨天中午當時的敘事時間不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: was testing 為過去進行式，符合電話打來時技師仍在測試的狀態。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: will test 為未來式，不能表達昨天中午當下正在進行的測試。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: has tested 為現在完成式，不能在此對應昨天中午尚未完成的測試狀態。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 過去進行式可描寫特定過去時刻正在進行的活動；仍未完成的資訊能加強此解讀。

questions.prompt: Before buying the brushes, please ask the art supply clerk {{q29}} between uses.

explanation.summary_zh: ask 後的嵌入問句使用 how they should be stored 的陳述語序。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 問題是畫筆在兩次使用之間應如何存放；嵌入 ask 後時，they 在 should 前，且畫筆是被存放的物品，因此使用被動式 be stored。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: how they should be stored 使用主詞在助動詞前的語序，並以被動式表達畫筆如何存放。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: how should they be stored 是直接問句語序，嵌入 ask 後不作這種主詞與助動詞倒裝。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 情態動詞 should 後須有原形動詞結構；storing 是 -ing 形式，不能在缺少 be 等原形動詞的情況下直接接在 should 後。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: how should store them 缺少執行存放動作的主詞，不能構成此處的完整嵌入問句。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 嵌入問句要保留疑問詞並用陳述語序，也要檢查動作與主詞的主被動關係。

questions.prompt: There will, {{q30}}, be no telephone consultations while the translation agency relocates its office.

explanation.summary_zh: regrettably 對搬遷期間無法提供電話諮詢這件事表達遺憾。
explanation.reasoning_zh: There will be no telephone consultations 是完整的存在句；will 與 be 之間用逗號隔開的 regrettably 評價整個情況，表達說話者對搬遷期間暫停諮詢的遺憾。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: regrets 可作名詞複數或第三人稱單數動詞，但這個以逗號隔開的位置不構成名詞片語或另一個限定子句。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: regrettable 是形容詞「令人遺憾的」；這個存在句沒有讓它作主詞補語或名詞修飾語的位置，不能直接代替評價整句的副詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: regret 是名詞或動詞原形；放在 will 與 be 之間的插入位置，不能構成本句所需的評價副詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: regrettably 是副詞，以逗號隔開作插入語，可對搬遷期間不提供電話諮詢這整件事表達遺憾。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 評價副詞可插入主句，用逗號隔開，表示說話者對整個命題的態度。

content.title: A Sofa Delivery Follow-up
content.scenario_summary: A studio owner thanks a furniture company after a postponed delivery: a trolley enables indoor transport, the delivery charge is refunded, and afternoon client meetings proceed unchanged.

blocks.text: To: Customer Care, Fenlow Furniture
Subject: My sofa delivery
Dear Customer Care Team,

Although my original delivery was postponed, I appreciated the way your team handled the new appointment. Marco arrived with my sofa yesterday and checked the route into my studio. {{q1}} He placed the sofa on it and pushed it across the lobby to my studio without having to carry it.
Marco, on {{q2}} advice I had cleared a space by the window, positioned the sofa exactly where I wanted it. He also took all the packaging away.
The delivery charge I paid when ordering has now been credited back to my bank account. I can therefore confirm that your office has {{q3}}, as promised after the postponement.
I {{q4}} my afternoon appointments. The sofa was in place before lunch, and I met every client at the originally agreed time and place. Please pass my thanks on to Marco.

Best regards,
Leila Santos

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

options.label: A
options.text: He brought a pair of lifting straps from his truck.

options.label: B
options.text: He brought a folding loading ramp from his truck.

options.label: C
options.text: He brought a flat trolley from his truck.

options.label: D
options.text: He brought some protective blankets from his truck.

explanation.summary_zh: 平板推車能承載沙發，讓搬運者直接推行而不必抬運。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後句有三個 it：第一個 on it 指承載沙發的平板推車，最後的 carry it 指沙發。中間 pushed it 可理解為推著推車上的沙發，或推動載著沙發的推車，不必限定為單一解讀。判斷關鍵是平板推車能讓沙發放在上面推過大廳，而無須抬著沙發走。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: lifting straps 是搬運吊帶，使用時仍須抬起家具，無法對應放在上面推過大廳的動作。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: loading ramp 是裝卸用斜坡板，能讓家具沿斜面移動；但本句描寫的是把沙發放在可推行的載具上，無須抬運便穿過大廳，平板推車較符合這個整體動作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: flat trolley 提供 on it 中 it 的明確指涉，並讓沙發能被推過大廳；句末 carry it 的 it 指沙發。中間 pushed it 不必限定只指推車，也可描述推著推車上的沙發。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: protective blankets 是複數的保護毯，無法自然提供 on it 中單數 it 的指涉；保護毯也不符合承載沙發並推行穿過大廳的載具。

evidence.quote: Although my original delivery was postponed, I appreciated the way your team handled the new appointment. Marco arrived with my sofa yesterday and checked the route into my studio. {{q1}} He placed the sofa on it and pushed it across the lobby to my studio without having to carry it.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空要把代名詞指涉與後續動作一起核對。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: on whose advice 表示「依照他的建議」，指 Marco 的建議。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 關係子句為 on whose advice I had cleared a space by the window；主詞是 I，動詞是 had cleared。on 的受詞是整個 whose advice，whose 將 advice 與先行詞 Marco 連起來，形成所有關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 可在適當結構中作介系詞受詞，但此處後面還有 advice；on whom advice 無法組成表示「依照他的建議」的名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose advice 表示 Marco 的建議，整個片語受 on 支配，符合本句的關係子句結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: which advice 可用於某些承接前述建議的結構，但此處先行詞是 Marco，前文也沒有一項建議讓 which advice 承接。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 無法在此處直接限定 advice 以表達 Marco 與建議的所有關係。

evidence.quote: Marco, on {{q2}} advice I had cleared a space by the window, positioned the sofa exactly where I wanted it. He also took all the packaging away.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到介系詞加關係詞，要檢查介系詞後整個名詞片語的結構。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 原先支付的運費已退回帳戶，證實公司已辦理退款。
explanation.reasoning_zh: credited back to my bank account 說明錢已返還；因此後句是在確認退款已完成。四個選項都能接在 has 後，但只有 issued a refund 與這個金流結果相符。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: requested a deposit 表示要求支付訂金，無法說明已付運費返還的結果。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: provided an estimate 表示提供估價；估價本身不能由款項退回帳戶來證實。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: sent a payment reminder 表示寄送付款提醒，與退回已付款項的結果不相符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: issued a refund 表示辦理退款，正是前句所述款項已退回帳戶的動作。

evidence.quote: The delivery charge I paid when ordering has now been credited back to my bank account. I can therefore confirm that your office has {{q3}}, as promised after the postponement.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 用上下文確認片語所指的交易方向與實際結果。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 交貨在午餐前完成，會面時間與地點都不必更改，因此保留原訂約會。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 單看 I ... my afternoon appointments，四個動詞都可能描述對約會的處理。後句說沙發午餐前已就位，並明確指出每位客戶都依原訂時間、地點會面，因而選 kept。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: kept 表示依原訂安排赴約，符合當天會面時間、地點都未改變的結果。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: canceled 表示取消，與後句當天仍與客戶會面的敘述不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: rescheduled 表示改期或調整時間，與後句依原訂時間會面的敘述不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: relocated 表示更換地點，但後句指出實際會面地點與原訂地點相同，並未搬換地點。

evidence.quote: I {{q4}} my afternoon appointments. The sofa was in place before lunch, and I met every client at the originally agreed time and place. Please pass my thanks on to Marco.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 情境動詞題可由相鄰句的原因與結果確認行動是否改變。

content.title: Learn to Keep Your Bicycle Running
content.scenario_summary: A bicycle repair workshop advertises practical classes, quoting a reader who kept a cherished bicycle after responding to an advertisement; learners practice on their own bicycles after watching demonstrations on workshop bicycles and booking limits ensure individual stand access.

blocks.text: Marlow Cycle Workshop
Keep riding. Start learning.

A loose cable or a worn brake pad need not mean the end of your bicycle. Our demonstrations make even unfamiliar repair procedures {{q1}} to beginners. Bring your bicycle to our Saturday morning class and learn with an experienced mechanic beside you.

“Your advertisement gave me hope that I could keep riding the bicycle my father gave me, instead of buying a new one. The workshop helped me {{q2}} it. I now know how to look after it properly.” — Leon, a recent participant

Participants practice on their own bicycles, while our mechanics use workshop bicycles for demonstrations. After watching an adjustment on a demonstration bicycle, you will make the same change to {{q3}}.
Every participant needs a repair stand for the full session. {{q4}} That way, nobody has to wait for someone else to finish before working on a bicycle.
Classes cost $45, including use of tools. Reserve your place at marlowcycle.example.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: accessible 作受詞補語，說明維修步驟變得容易理解。
explanation.reasoning_zh: make 的受詞是 even unfamiliar repair procedures，空格位於受詞之後，用來描述這些程序經示範後呈現的狀態。accessible to beginners 表示初學者也能理解、掌握，符合本句的使役結構。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: accessibility 是名詞「可及性／易用性」，不能在此處直接描述 procedures 的狀態；make 的名詞補語須能與受詞形成合理關係，本句並非把程序變成一種「可及性」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: accessibly 是副詞；此處要補充說明 procedures 變得如何，而非以副詞說明 make 的方式。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: access 可作名詞或動詞，但放入此處的 make procedures access to beginners 無法形成符合本句意思的補語結構。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: accessible 是形容詞，作 procedures 的受詞補語；to beginners 指對初學者而言容易理解。

evidence.quote: A loose cable or a worn brake pad need not mean the end of your bicycle. Our demonstrations make even unfamiliar repair procedures {{q1}} to beginners. Bring your bicycle to our Saturday morning class and learn with an experienced mechanic beside you.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨認 make 後的受詞與補語，不要只看空格前後的單字。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: Leon 希望繼續騎父親送的車，retain 表示保留下來。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說 Leon 想繼續使用原本的腳踏車，而不買新車；後句也說他已學會好好保養它。因此 helped me retain it 表示課程幫助他保留這輛車並繼續使用。單看空格所在句，四個動詞都能搭配腳踏車，須靠前後文確認目的。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: exchange 表示交換，會將原本這輛車換出去，與繼續騎父親送的原車這個目的不同。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: retain 表示保留，符合繼續使用原車而不另買一輛的目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: donate 表示捐贈，會把這輛車交給別人，無法達成繼續使用原車的目的。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: sell 表示出售，與保留原車繼續騎乘的目的相反。

evidence.quote: “Your advertisement gave me hope that I could keep riding the bicycle my father gave me, instead of buying a new one. The workshop helped me {{q2}} it. I now know how to look after it properly.” — Leon, a recent participant

explanation.takeaway_zh: 情境字彙題先找當事人的具體目的，再確認動詞是否達成目的。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: yours 指讀者自己帶來、用於實作練習的腳踏車。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句區分兩組車：學員用自己的車練習，技師用工作坊的車示範。後句轉而直接對讀者說 you，要求看完示範後在自己的車上做相同調整，因此以 yours 代替 your bicycle。單看空格所在句，並未指定實作所用車輛的歸屬。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: ours 指廣告刊登者這一方的車，對應前句工作坊用來示範的車；實作練習則指定使用學員自己的車。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: theirs 指第三人稱群體的車，可能讓人想到技師或其他學員；但本句直接對讀者說 you，所要調整的是讀者自己的車。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: yours 代替 your bicycle，接續前句學員在自己車上練習的安排，並配合後句直接稱呼讀者的 you。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: one another's 表示彼此的車，會變成學員互相調整對方的車，與前句各自在自己車上練習的安排不同。

evidence.quote: Participants practice on their own bicycles, while our mechanics use workshop bicycles for demonstrations. After watching an adjustment on a demonstration bicycle, you will make the same change to {{q3}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 所有格指涉題先分清物品屬於誰，再注意第三人稱描述是否轉成直接對讀者說話。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: We accept no more bookings than the number of stands available.

options.label: B
options.text: We ask participants to arrive in the order of their bookings.

options.label: C
options.text: We assign a single stand to each pair of participants.

options.label: D
options.text: We spend the first half hour showing participants the available stands.

explanation.summary_zh: 預約人數不超過維修架數量，才能讓每位學員全程都有架可用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說每位學員整堂課都需要維修架；後句說這樣就不必等別人修完才能開始。限制預約人數不超過架數，能把需要與結果連起來。其餘安排並未提供每人同時使用一座維修架的條件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 限制人數不超過維修架數，便能讓每人同時使用一座，符合前後的因果關係。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 依預約順序抵達只決定到場順序，並未限制總人數或確保每人全程都有維修架，無法推出不用等人的結果。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 兩人共用一座維修架，與每人整堂課都需要一座的條件衝突，也可能必須輪流等待。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 先花半小時介紹維修架，不能保證架數足以供所有學員同時使用，因此無法說明後句的結果。

evidence.quote: Every participant needs a repair stand for the full session. {{q4}} That way, nobody has to wait for someone else to finish before working on a bicycle.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空要確認選項實際解決前句的需求，並能導致後句的結果。

content.title: Rethinking the Harbor Tour
content.scenario_summary: A harbor-tour founder tests slower trips featuring dockworker interviews, revises a concern about boring guests after enthusiastic feedback, and commissions further trials before changing the regular route.

documents.title: A new direction for our harbor tour

blocks.text: To: Harborline Tours staff
From: Mira Bell, Founder
Subject: A new direction for our harbor tour

I founded Harborline around quick trips past the harbor landmarks. Last week, we tested a slower tour focused on the people who work here. Six dockworkers agreed to speak to our guests. We arranged short interviews with {{q1}} during the trial.
The interviews added thirty minutes to the trip. {{q2}}, we returned at 11:30 rather than the originally scheduled 11:00.

I had worried that stopping to listen would bore our guests. My concern now seems {{q3}}. Every guest named the interviews as the best part of the trip, and several requested longer conversations next time.

{{q4}} I am therefore asking the team to run three more trials before we decide whether to replace our usual route. Please record guest feedback after each trip; I want our next decision to rest on more than one successful morning.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: them 指前句同意與遊客交談的六位碼頭工作人員。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句介紹 Six dockworkers，接著說安排與某些人的簡短訪談。此處用受格複數代名詞 them 接續這六位工作人員；we 則是安排訪談的旅遊公司這一方。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: him 指單數男性，前句引入的是六位工作人員，沒有可對應的單一男性受訪者。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: ourselves 指 we 自己，會變成安排與公司自己人的訪談，並未接續前句同意受訪的碼頭工作人員。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是受格複數代名詞，接在 with 後，指前句六位同意與遊客交談的人。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: it 指單數事物，不符合前句引入的六位受訪者。

evidence.quote: I founded Harborline around quick trips past the harbor landmarks. Last week, we tested a slower tour focused on the people who work here. Six dockworkers agreed to speak to our guests. We arranged short interviews with {{q1}} during the trial.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先確認前句引入的人物群體，再選符合人稱與數量的代名詞。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 訪談增加三十分鐘，因此返航時間從十一點延至十一點半。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句提供行程多出三十分鐘的原因，後句敘述實際晚三十分鐘返航的結果。Therefore 清楚連接這個因果關係；其餘選項分別表示讓步、另一種情況或取代，與這裡的關係不同。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Nevertheless 表示儘管如此，但多花三十分鐘與晚三十分鐘返航相符，並非違背前句預期的結果。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Therefore 表示因此，將訪談延長行程與較晚返航連成因果關係。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Otherwise 通常引出若非如此的另一種情況；此處十一點半是加入訪談後實際發生的返航時間，並非沒有訪談時的結果。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Instead 表示取而代之；後句是在敘述加上訪談造成的返航延後，並不是以返航取代前句的訪談。

evidence.quote: The interviews added thirty minutes to the trip. {{q2}}, we returned at 11:30 rather than the originally scheduled 11:00.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 用前後兩句的實際關係選連接詞，不只看單句中的時間或比較字眼。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 遊客一致把訪談評為最精彩的部分，顯示擔心訪談無聊是多慮了。
explanation.reasoning_zh: concern 指前句「停下來聽訪談會讓遊客無聊」的擔憂。後句提供相反的實際回饋：每位遊客都最喜歡訪談，還有人希望聊久一點。因此 misplaced 表示這個擔憂在本次體驗下顯得沒有必要。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: justified 表示有根據、合理，但本次所有遊客的正面評價不支持無聊的擔憂。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: understated 表示表達得太輕，暗示實際問題比原先擔心的更嚴重；遊客的回饋並未顯示無聊問題。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: unresolved 表示仍未獲得解答，但這次體驗已直接提供遊客喜歡訪談的回饋，作者也據此重新評估原先的擔憂。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: misplaced 指擔憂放錯了地方、沒有必要，符合遊客一致喜愛訪談並希望延長對談的結果。

evidence.quote: I had worried that stopping to listen would bore our guests. My concern now seems {{q3}}. Every guest named the interviews as the best part of the trip, and several requested longer conversations next time.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷評價字時，先找出被評價的原先想法，再用實際回饋確認評價方向。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: One successful trial is promising, but it does not establish how the new tour will perform over time.

options.label: B
options.text: One successful trial is enough to establish how well the new tour will perform throughout the season.

options.label: C
options.text: This trial is encouraging mainly because it shows which weekday attracts the most passengers.

options.label: D
options.text: This trial leaves us unable to judge the interviews because we have not received any guest feedback.

explanation.summary_zh: 一次成功值得肯定，但不足以判斷長期表現，因此還要再試三次。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 上一段提供本次試辦的正面回饋；下一句用 therefore 說明要增加三次試辦，再決定是否更換原路線。正確選項既承認成功，也指出僅一次經驗的限制，能解釋為何還需要更多資料。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句肯定一次試辦的成功，同時保留對長期表現的判斷，正好說明後面為何要再辦三次並蒐集回饋。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句宣稱一次試辦足以判斷整季表現，與作者要蒐集更多試辦資料、再決定是否更換路線的理由不合。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中沒有比較各星期幾的載客量，這不是本次訪談試辦所建立的結果，也不能解釋後面針對遊客回饋的安排。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 上一段已列出每位遊客最喜歡的部分及希望延長對談的意見，因此「尚未收到任何遊客回饋」與文中事實不符。

evidence.quote: I had worried that stopping to listen would bore our guests. My concern now seems {{q3}}. Every guest named the interviews as the best part of the trip, and several requested longer conversations next time.

{{q4}} I am therefore asking the team to run three more trials before we decide whether to replace our usual route. Please record guest feedback after each trip; I want our next decision to rest on more than one successful morning.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 評價橋接句須兼顧已有成果與尚缺證據，才能解釋後續決策。

content.title: Recognizing the Work Behind a New Feature
content.scenario_summary: A coworking-space employee adds self-service booking cancellation, demonstrates its limited effect on individual reservations, and conditions his bonus acceptance on equal recognition of the receptionist whose notes enabled the change.

documents.title: A Small Fix with a Lasting Effect

blocks.text: A Small Fix with a Lasting Effect

At Alder Yard, a coworking space, receptionist Hana Mori used to spend each morning processing meeting-room cancellations. Her colleague Ellis Grant added a feature to the booking website. Now a cancellation request can {{q1}} directly through a member account.
The feature {{q2}} the need for staff to process each cancellation. It updates the room calendar automatically, without any staff action.

Some members asked whether canceling one meeting would also erase their later bookings. {{q3}} To confirm his explanation, he canceled tomorrow's meeting on screen. It disappeared immediately, while every later booking remained unchanged.

Management offered Ellis a bonus for the improvement. He said he would accept it only if the same amount went to Hana, whose detailed notes had made the change possible. Management agreed to this {{q4}}, and both colleagues received equal payments.
“Ellis wrote the software, but he made sure the work behind it was recognized too,” Hana said. “That matters as much as the time we save.”

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: request 是被提交的申請，因此用 can be submitted。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本句主詞是 a cancellation request；會員透過帳號提交這項申請，申請本身是接受動作的一方。can 後接 be submitted，構成情態動詞加被動式，表示申請現在可以直接線上提交。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: submit 是主動原形；放入本句會把申請當成提交動作的執行者，且沒有交代其提交的對象，不符合此處會員提交申請的意思。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: have submitted 是主動完成式，仍把 request 當作提交者，也不是本句要表達的「可被提交」功能。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: be submitting 是主動進行式，將 request 描述成正在提交東西，與申請接受提交動作的角色不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: be submitted 與 can 組成被動式，表示會員可透過帳號提交取消申請。

evidence.quote: At Alder Yard, a coworking space, receptionist Hana Mori used to spend each morning processing meeting-room cancellations. Her colleague Ellis Grant added a feature to the booking website. Now a cancellation request can {{q1}} directly through a member account.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷情態被動式時，先確認主詞與該動作的施受關係。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 系統自動更新且不需員工操作，因此消除了人工處理每項取消的必要。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 單看 The feature ... the need，四個動詞都能表達新功能與人力需求的不同關係。後句說系統會自動更新日曆，而且完全不需員工操作，才確認此處是 eliminated，即不再需要逐筆人工處理。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: highlighted 表示凸顯需求，但後句描述的是無須員工操作，並未說新功能使人工需求更加明顯。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: eliminated 表示消除，符合系統自動完成更新、不再需要逐筆人工處理的結果。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: increased 表示增加，與系統不需員工操作的功能結果相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: concealed 表示把仍存在的需求隱藏起來，但後句說流程本身不需要員工操作，並非把人工需求遮掩起來。

evidence.quote: The feature {{q2}} the need for staff to process each cancellation. It updates the room calendar automatically, without any staff action.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 因果字彙題要核對機制實際改變了什麼，而非只判斷動詞搭配是否自然。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Ellis explained that canceling one meeting would erase all later bookings too.

options.label: B
options.text: Ellis explained that a meeting could be canceled only after its start time.

options.label: C
options.text: Ellis explained that only the selected booking would be removed.

options.label: D
options.text: Ellis explained that a canceled meeting would remain visible until the next day.

explanation.summary_zh: 示範立即刪除所選會議、保留後續預約，證實只有所選預約會移除。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 會員先問取消一次會議是否影響後續預約。空格後的 To confirm his explanation 明確把示範當作對前句說明的驗證：明天的會議立即消失，後續預約完全不變。因此前句必須是只移除所選預約的說明，而非其他取消效果或限制。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句說所有後續預約也會刪除，但示範中每個後續預約都維持原樣，無法由這次示範證實。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句把取消限制在開始時間之後，但示範取消的是明天的會議，尚未到開始時間，與此限制不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句說只移除所選預約；示範中所選會議立即消失，而後續預約不變，正好證實這個說明。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句說取消後仍會顯示到隔天，但示範中的會議立即消失，與這個延遲效果不符。

evidence.quote: Some members asked whether canceling one meeting would also erase their later bookings. {{q3}} To confirm his explanation, he canceled tomorrow's meeting on screen. It disappeared immediately, while every later booking remained unchanged.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 當後句明說要驗證前面的說明，須檢查實際結果是否確實支持該說明。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: this condition 指 Ellis 接受獎金的前提：Hana 也必須獲得同額獎金。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 管理層先提出給 Ellis 獎金；Ellis 並非單純預測或反對，而是用 only if 為自己的接受設定前提。Management agreed to this ... 承接的就是這個條件，後文兩人領取同額款項也顯示條件已落實。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: condition 表示條件，接續 only if 所設定的同額給付前提；後面兩人得到一樣多的獎金，確認管理層接受了該條件。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: prediction 表示預測，但 Ellis 說的是自己在何種前提下願意接受獎金，並非預測 Hana 將獲得什麼。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: objection 表示反對意見；Ellis 沒有要求撤銷獎金，而是提出願意接受的具體前提，因此 condition 更準確地指回這個行為。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: comparison 表示比較；same amount 雖涉及金額相同，但整句是在設定接受獎金的條件，不只是比較兩筆金額。

evidence.quote: Management offered Ellis a bonus for the improvement. He said he would accept it only if the same amount went to Hana, whose detailed notes had made the change possible. Management agreed to this {{q4}}, and both colleagues received equal payments.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨識事件指涉時，要看前句做了什麼溝通行為，不能只抓其中一個詞。

content.title: Recruitment Clinic: Next Visit
content.scenario_summary: A career centre coordinator schedules a return to a staffing agency after a promised individual résumé clinic became a group presentation that left participants with unanswered questions.

blocks.text: Recruitment Clinic: Next Visit
Brookmere Career Centre | Notice to job seekers

Last month's clinic at Vale Staffing was advertised as a chance to receive individual advice on résumés. We attended a group presentation instead. The examples were clear, but they left most of our group's questions about employment gaps unanswered.

I have booked another visit for our group on June 18, when the agency will provide individual appointments. Participants will meet the same advisers who gave the presentation. Please send me your résumé questions by June 10 so that the advisers have time to prepare their responses. I will collect the questions and forward them together.
The visit is open to anyone registered with our centre, including those who missed the first clinic. Sign up at reception by June 12; appointment times will be sent by e-mail.
Mara Chen, Career Centre Coordinator

questions.prompt: What does the notice suggest about Ms. Chen's attitude toward Vale Staffing?

options.label: A
options.text: She is satisfied with its advice and willing to use its services again.

options.label: B
options.text: She is dissatisfied with its advice and unwilling to use its services again.

options.label: C
options.text: She is not fully satisfied with its advice but willing to give it another chance.

options.label: D
options.text: She is satisfied with its advice but unwilling to arrange further visits.

explanation.summary_zh: 她對上次提供的建議並未完全滿意，但仍願意再給這家機構一次機會。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 上次的範例雖然清楚，卻沒有解答團員大部分關於就業空窗期的疑問，顯示服務有不足之處；她又替團體預約下一次到訪，顯示仍願意繼續使用服務。兩項資訊合起來支持 C。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 雖然她願意再使用服務，但大部分相關疑問仍未獲解答，不能只因範例清楚就判定她滿意整體建議。

content.title: Ask from Home

blocks.text: Harbridge Museum: Ask from Home
Our new telephone service brings the exhibition Journeys by Rail to visitors who cannot get to the museum. Book a free fifteen-minute call to discuss the posters, luggage, and photographs on display.

Among the exhibits are six travel diaries that Felix Duarte inherited from his grandmother. He has kept them in their original leather cases for thirty years. After the exhibition closes in November, museum staff will pack the diaries for their return to his home.

To arrange a call, contact Rosa Bell in visitor services through our booking form. She assigns an appointment time and sends a confirmation. Exhibition guides conduct the calls and answer questions about the objects. For background before your appointment, listen to the recorded introduction by curator Theo Mills. The recording also includes a short interview with conservator Anika Reed, who prepared the diaries for display.
Calls are available on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. Please mention any particular exhibit you would like to discuss when booking.

content.title: A refund without an argument
content.scenario_summary: A customer prefers a bank refund to store credit for uncomfortable boots. A straightforward in-store return earns her approval despite the refund arriving while her training course is underway.

blocks.text: A refund without an argument
Review of Ridgeway Outdoor | Posted July 22 by Tessa Lane | 4 out of 5 stars

The walking boots I ordered from Ridgeway arrived on July 2. They looked good but pinched my toes, and I wanted a refund rather than another pair. I called the shop on July 3. The person who answered offered immediate store credit, but accepted my preference for a refund to my bank account without trying to change my mind.

On July 4, I handed the boots to an employee at the returns desk beside the shop's side entrance. The main counter was busy with sales, so I appreciated having a separate place to go. I also noticed a collection point for online orders near the back stairs.

My training course ran from July 8 to July 19, and I had quite enough to organize before it began. The refund appeared in my bank account on July 10. I would have liked the money sooner, but I didn't have to call again or fill in more forms. That straightforward service has won me over. I'll check Ridgeway first when I next need outdoor clothing.

content.title: Continuing the Reading Parcel Program
content.scenario_summary: An independent bookshop reports strong renewals from a personalized book subscription pilot and asks its distributor to extend introductory shipping rates; selected titles move from ordering to shop arrival and customer collection.

blocks.text: March 25

Ms. Elena Voss
Trade Accounts, Briar Books Distribution
Dear Ms. Voss,

I am writing to ask whether you can continue the reduced shipping rate you offered for the first month of our Reading Parcel program at Larch Lane Books. The pilot has been a success, and we would like to make it a regular service. [[1]]

On March 2, our twenty participants each chose a preferred genre and named a book they had recently enjoyed. My colleague and I used their responses to select one new title for each person. [[2]] Three days later, that shipment arrived at our shop, complete and in excellent condition.

We added a handwritten note explaining each recommendation and sent everyone a collection reminder. By March 10, all twenty participants had collected their parcels from the shop. [[3]] Eighteen have already signed up for another month, exceeding our target of fifteen renewals.

We expect to place a similar-sized order in April. Keeping the introductory shipping rate would allow us to maintain the current subscription price. [[4]] Please let me know by April 2 whether you can offer that rate for the next three months.

Yours sincerely,
Nadia Holt
Owner, Larch Lane Books

questions.prompt: Where would this sentence fit most naturally in the passage? "The following morning, I ordered those titles from your company for the first time."
questions.target_text: The following morning, I ordered those titles from your company for the first time.

explanation.summary_zh: 插入句接在選好書目之後，讓下句的到貨能銜接已下訂的貨品。

option_analysis.reason_zh: [1] 前只有方案成功及運費請求，尚未介紹可供 those titles 回指的選定書目；後面才開始三月二日的選書過程。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: [2] 前剛選出每人的書目，插入隔天下訂的步驟後，下句便能接續那批貨在三天後送達。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: [3] 前所有參加者都已在三月十日前領到書，若此時才接「隔天首次向貴公司訂購那些書」，會將首批下單放在到貨、領取之後。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: [4] 位於下個月訂單與續用優惠運費的討論中，首批書已完成交付；插入句描述首次訂購的過去步驟，既無相鄰選書事件可接，也破壞首批已到貨的順序。

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Holt write to Ms. Voss?

options.label: A
options.text: To ask for a lower price on individual books

options.label: B
options.text: To request that an incomplete shipment be replaced

options.label: C
options.text: To seek an extension of a temporary shipping discount

options.label: D
options.text: To invite her to choose books for the next subscription

explanation.summary_zh: 這封信主要請求延長試辦期間的運費優惠。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 開頭明確詢問能否繼續第一個月的優惠運費，結尾又請對方在四月二日前確認能否延長三個月。試辦成果是支持這項請求的理由，不是另外提出選書或補寄的要求。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中想維持的是運費優惠，沒有要求調降每本書的售價。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中說首批貨完整且狀況良好，沒有要求補寄或更換缺漏的貨品。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 開頭與結尾都要求續用暫時性的運費優惠，因此這是寫信的主要目的。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 書目是書店與同事依讀者回覆挑選，信中沒有邀請 Voss 女士替下一期選書。

We expect to place a similar-sized order in April. Keeping the introductory shipping rate would allow us to maintain the current subscription price. [[4]] Please let me know by April 2 whether you can offer that rate for the next three months.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題區分寫信希望對方做的事，以及支持該請求的背景成果。

questions.prompt: Which service was NOT provided to participants during the pilot?

options.label: A
options.text: Selecting books based on their reading preferences

options.label: B
options.text: Including a personal explanation of each selection

options.label: C
options.text: Sending a notice that their parcels could be collected

options.label: D
options.text: Delivering their parcels to their homes

explanation.summary_zh: 試辦採到店取書，沒有提供把包裹送到參加者家中的服務。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 書店依每人的類型偏好與最近喜歡的書選書，附上手寫推薦說明，並寄送取書提醒。文章又說二十位參加者全數到店領取，因此宅配到家不是這次試辦提供的服務。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 三月二日蒐集讀者偏好後，書店依回覆為每人選一本新書，支持此選項。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 每份包裹附有解釋推薦原因的手寫便條，支持個別選書說明這項服務。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中明確說寄送 collection reminder，也就是提醒讀者領取包裹，支持此選項。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 全部二十位讀者都從書店領走包裹；文中的供應商到貨是送到書店，不能當成送到讀者家的服務。

My colleague and I used their responses to select one new title for each person. [[2]] Three days later, that shipment arrived at our shop, complete and in excellent condition.

We added a handwritten note explaining each recommendation and sent everyone a collection reminder. By March 10, all twenty participants had collected their parcels from the shop. [[3]] Eighteen have already signed up for another month, exceeding our target of fifteen renewals.

content.title: Recommendations After a Recruitment Trial
content.scenario_summary: Following a work-sample recruitment trial, employee assessors are instructed to create evidence-based summaries and privately record preliminary views before group discussion; trial observations suggest a concern about senior-member influence.

documents.title: Recruitment Work Samples: Preparing Your Recommendation

blocks.text: Recruitment Work Samples: Preparing Your Recommendation

For employees assigned to assess applicants during a paid work-sample session. These instructions cover the recommendation stage only; the recruitment coordinator handles invitations, scheduling, and payment. Applicants receive a separate guide to the exercise.
Use the revised procedure below following our trial of work-sample assessments in May. Each assessor must complete the steps in order. [[1]]
1. Prepare the assessment

After the exercise ends, save the applicant's completed response as a PDF in the recruitment folder. [[2]] Begin this page with your recommendation, then describe two observations from the exercise that support it. Include the applicant's identification number but omit their name. Do not edit the applicant's original response.
2. Submit before discussion

Upload your completed summary to the panel folder and send your preliminary recommendation privately to the recruitment coordinator before the group discussion. [[3]] The coordinator will preserve these initial recommendations alongside the final decision.

During the May trial, some assessors filled in their recommendation only after hearing the senior panel member speak. Their recommendations generally followed that member's view, even when their own observation notes differed from it. [[4]]
3. Record the outcome

At the meeting, compare the observations rather than simply counting favorable recommendations. If the discussion changes your view, add a dated explanation to your summary; leave the original recommendation visible. The panel chair will then send the agreed outcome to the recruitment coordinator, who will contact the applicant.

questions.prompt: Where would this sentence fit most naturally in the passage? "Using that saved response, create a separate one-page summary of your assessment."
questions.target_text: Using that saved response, create a separate one-page summary of your assessment.

explanation.summary_zh: 先儲存作答檔，再建立評估摘要，才能接續說明該頁要寫哪些內容。
explanation.reasoning_zh: that saved response 必須接續剛存成 PDF 的作答；插入句再引入獨立的一頁摘要，供下句 this page 指稱。後文要求完成並上傳摘要，因此建立摘要的步驟要放在 [2]，而非已上傳之後。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: [1] 位於各步驟開始前，還沒有儲存作答的動作可讓 that saved response 回指，且後文要求按順序執行。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: [2] 前已把作答存成 PDF；此處建立一頁摘要後，下一句便能說明這一頁的開頭和內容，前後動作完整。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: [3] 前已要求上傳 completed summary；若到這裡才建立摘要，會把建立放在完成、上傳之後，與依序執行的要求衝突。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: [4] 已在上傳步驟之後，且緊接的是五月試辦的觀察；此處才建立新摘要既無法銜接該段事件，也晚於先前的完成及上傳步驟。

evidence.quote: Use the revised procedure below following our trial of work-sample assessments in May. Each assessor must complete the steps in order. [[1]]

After the exercise ends, save the applicant's completed response as a PDF in the recruitment folder. [[2]] Begin this page with your recommendation, then describe two observations from the exercise that support it. Include the applicant's identification number but omit their name. Do not edit the applicant's original response.

Upload your completed summary to the panel folder and send your preliminary recommendation privately to the recruitment coordinator before the group discussion. [[3]] The coordinator will preserve these initial recommendations alongside the final decision.

During the May trial, some assessors filled in their recommendation only after hearing the senior panel member speak. Their recommendations generally followed that member's view, even when their own observation notes differed from it. [[4]]

explanation.takeaway_zh: 新指涉插入題除了找代名詞來源，也要核對新物件的建立、使用和提交順序。

questions.prompt: In the instructions, the word "support" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: support 在此指用觀察結果支持、證成建議。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句中要求寫出兩項在實作中觀察到的事實，讓建議有依據。因此 support 在這裡是 justify，即證成、提供合理根據，不是金錢資助或實體支撐。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: finance 指提供資金；此處 observations 是評估證據，並非出資的來源。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: carry 指搬運或承載，適用於其他情境；此處觀察結果是在為建議提供依據。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: justify 指提供合理依據，符合用兩項觀察支持推薦意見的意思。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: accommodate 指容納或配合需求，不能替代本句「以證據支持建議」的關係。

evidence.quote: After the exercise ends, save the applicant's completed response as a PDF in the recruitment folder. [[2]] Begin this page with your recommendation, then describe two observations from the exercise that support it. Include the applicant's identification number but omit their name. Do not edit the applicant's original response.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義字要結合主詞與受詞：觀察結果支持建議，是證據關係。

questions.prompt: Who should follow these instructions?

options.label: A
options.text: Employees who evaluate applicants in work-sample sessions

options.label: B
options.text: Coordinators who arrange applicants' appointments and payments

options.label: C
options.text: Applicants who are preparing for a paid assessment exercise

options.label: D
options.text: Panel chairs who notify applicants of hiring decisions

explanation.summary_zh: 適用對象是受指派評估應徵者實作表現的員工。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 開頭明確寫 For employees assigned to assess applicants，並把邀請、排程及付款交給招募協調員，也說應徵者另有指南。因此本文的讀者是實作評估人員，而不是協調員或應徵者。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 開頭直接指定受指派評估應徵者的員工，與此選項相符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 招募協調員負責邀請、排程與付款，文中把這些工作與本文的評估建議階段區分開來。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 應徵者會收到另一份實作指南，並非這份內部評估指示的指定讀者。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 評審主席只把共同結論送給協調員，通知應徵者是協調員的工作；此選項把通知職責分配錯了。

evidence.quote: For employees assigned to assess applicants during a paid work-sample session. These instructions cover the recommendation stage only; the recruitment coordinator handles invitations, scheduling, and payment. Applicants receive a separate guide to the exercise.

At the meeting, compare the observations rather than simply counting favorable recommendations. If the discussion changes your view, add a dated explanation to your summary; leave the original recommendation visible. The panel chair will then send the agreed outcome to the recruitment coordinator, who will contact the applicant.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 讀者題優先找明示的適用對象，並區分文中其他被提及的角色。

questions.prompt: Why are assessors most likely required to submit preliminary recommendations before the group discussion?

options.label: A
options.text: To let the coordinator resolve differences before the panel meets

options.label: B
options.text: To provide an advance count of favorable recommendations

options.label: C
options.text: To align assessors' recommendations with the senior member's view

options.label: D
options.text: To capture assessors' views before a senior colleague influences them

explanation.summary_zh: 先提交可以留下評估人員尚未受資深成員影響的原始判斷。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 新規定要求在討論前私下提交並保留初步意見；試辦時，等資深成員發言後才填寫的人，意見往往跟隨該成員，即使自己的觀察筆記不同。結合兩點，可推知提前提交是為了先記錄各人獨立形成的看法。文中並未禁止討論後改變意見。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 私下提前提交確實可讓協調員看到不同意見，但文中只說協調員保留紀錄；比較觀察及形成共同結論仍在會議中進行，沒有先由協調員調解歧見的安排。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 提前取得建議可能方便計數，但這只是可能的行政用途。文中要求討論時比較觀察，而非只計算贊成數；試辦所呈現的是個人筆記與聽後填寫的建議不一致，較支持保留原始判斷的目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 試辦時聽過資深成員發言後才填寫的建議，本來就往往跟隨該成員。新規定改在討論前提交，並未提供讓評估者先對齊資深成員看法的步驟，因此不支持以增加這種一致性為目的。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 先提交並保留原始意見，對照試辦時聽完資深成員發言後才填寫建議的評估者，其建議往往跟隨該成員、甚至與自己的觀察筆記不同，可推知是要留下受影響前的個人判斷。

evidence.quote: Upload your completed summary to the panel folder and send your preliminary recommendation privately to the recruitment coordinator before the group discussion. [[3]] The coordinator will preserve these initial recommendations alongside the final decision.

During the May trial, some assessors filled in their recommendation only after hearing the senior panel member speak. Their recommendations generally followed that member's view, even when their own observation notes differed from it. [[4]]

At the meeting, compare the observations rather than simply counting favorable recommendations. If the discussion changes your view, add a dated explanation to your summary; leave the original recommendation visible. The panel chair will then send the agreed outcome to the recruitment coordinator, who will contact the applicant.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 動機推論要把新措施與先前觀察到的情況連起來，避免把一般職場慣例當作證據。

content.title: A Few Stitches Make a Difference
content.scenario_summary: A neighbourhood coat-mending gathering develops into a successful free volunteer programme. A spring collection gains radio attention, while advance photos help coordinate specialist skills and yield unplanned practical benefits.

documents.title: A Few Stitches Make a Difference

blocks.text: A Few Stitches Make a Difference
By Claire Yuen | Westbridge Gazette | June 3

In 2018, Omar Bell invited five neighbours to his kitchen to mend coats for families in their street. They brought their own sewing supplies and met again the following month. Westbridge's volunteer clothing-repair programme, now based at the community centre, grew from those kitchen gatherings.

The idea took off after a local shop began displaying photographs of repaired garments. These days, twenty volunteers mend everything from school trousers to winter jackets, and the service remains free.

This spring's collection ran from May 4 to May 25. Residents left garments at the centre for repair during the following month. A radio feature about the programme aired on May 12 and brought inquiries from neighbouring towns. By the end of the collection period, the volunteers had received 180 garments.

Residents now send a photograph before dropping off a garment. 'We were accepting jobs on days when nobody present knew how to do them,' says coordinator Helen Wu. She asked for photographs so she could arrange each session around the skills its repairs would require. Volunteers later began using the images to estimate material needs and select examples for training new members. Residents have also reported shorter waits.

Next month, the centre will begin lending sewing kits to residents who want to practise at home. Volunteers will show borrowers how to use the tools, but the regular repair sessions will continue. 'Sometimes people want to learn; sometimes they simply need a coat they can wear,' Wu says.

content.title: A Delayed Demonstration Shipment
content.scenario_summary: A shipment of demonstration amplifiers is held for damage checks. A staff notice sets out substitute-equipment clearance and dealer-loan authorization. Rosa arranges temporary coverage during Mina’s leave, retains a preview date despite a less complete demonstration, and coordinates borrowing an older amplifier.

blocks.text: Harrow Audio — Staff Notice
September 8 | Demonstration equipment

Our shipment of AX40 demonstration amplifiers has been delayed after several cartons were damaged in transit. The supplier is checking the contents and will issue a revised shipping update tomorrow. Showroom appointments remain on the calendar while we explore alternatives.

For any substitute amplifier, the technician conducting the sound check must send a completed clearance sheet to the colleague preparing the dealer invitations. That colleague can then confirm the equipment details in the invitations. The sheet should identify the model tested and any features unavailable on it.

The showroom manager must authorize any equipment borrowed from a dealer. Please obtain this authorization before arranging collection. Loan equipment should be returned in its original packaging, so keep the cartons in the storeroom until the event ends.
Printed AX40 brochures and demonstration headphones are already available at reception. Staff may collect them for the dealer sessions.
From: Rosa Chen <rosa.chen@harrowaudio.example>
To: Caleb Moss <caleb.moss@harrowaudio.example>
Date: September 9
Subject: Mina’s tasks for the preview
Hi Caleb,

With Mina starting her leave tomorrow, could you cover her sound checks for the dealer preview? I have taken over her invitation list and will prepare the messages myself. Please let me know this afternoon whether you can help, so I can settle the arrangements before she leaves.

Adrian Bell has agreed to authorize the loan of an older amplifier from Westbank Electronics. Its bass performance would make it less useful for comparing the new model’s sound, but visitors could still try the controls and headphone connections. I have therefore kept our September 15 showroom booking.

Westbank can make the amplifier available tomorrow morning. I will arrange collection after Adrian signs the paperwork. Mina has left her usual test recordings on the workbench, and the supplier’s shipping update is in the shared folder if you need it.

Thanks,
Rosa

content.title: Preparing for Revised Fitness Equipment
content.scenario_summary: A fitness-equipment supplier replaces a freestanding rack with a wall-mounted version and changes the mat coating. The center accepts the revised equipment, arranges room preparations and a separate demonstration location, and cancels the cleaner made unnecessary by the coating while retaining a delayed disinfectant order.

blocks.text: From: Leah Voss <leah.voss@kestrelfit.example>
To: Owen Hale <owen.hale@elmfitness.example>
Date: November 3
Subject: Please confirm revised equipment for Elm Fitness
Dear Owen,

The manufacturer has replaced the freestanding mat rack you ordered for Studio B with a wall-mounted version. It needs a clear section of wall 2.4 meters wide. The number of mats it holds is unchanged. Please confirm that the revised rack is acceptable before we release your order for production.

Your new mats also have a different protective coating. Plain water is now recommended for cleaning them, so the Aster foam cleaner on your order is unnecessary. Separately, our Grove disinfectant will be out of stock until November 20. You may prefer to source that product locally if you need it sooner.

The equipment can still arrive on November 12. Please allow two hours for installation, including a demonstration of the rack’s locking mechanism. There is no change to the equipment price or installation charge.

Best regards,
Leah
From: Owen Hale <owen.hale@elmfitness.example>
To: Elm Fitness staff <staff@elmfitness.example>
Date: November 4
Subject: Work before the equipment delivery
Hello everyone,

I have accepted Kestrel’s revised equipment proposal. On November 11, please move the noticeboard off the long wall in Studio A and the low storage cabinet away from the long wall in Studio B. Both can go in the equipment room for now. We will decide on permanent positions after the installation.

On delivery day, the van will unload at the service entrance. Once the installer has finished, meet her in Studio A for the demonstration; she is bringing a small display model for that session. Please leave the reception area clear for members arriving for classes.
I have canceled the Aster order but left the Grove order open. We have enough Grove in the storeroom to cover the next three weeks. Please adjust the purchase records accordingly.

Thanks,
Owen

questions.prompt: In Ms. Voss’s email, the word “allow” is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: allow two hours 在此表示預留兩小時。
explanation.reasoning_zh: allow 的受詞是 two hours，for installation 指出這段時間的用途；此處是請健身中心安排足夠時間，不是授權安裝或容忍某件事。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: authorize 表示授權或批准，不能在此替換成 authorize two hours for installation 來表達預留時間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: predict 表示預測；這裡是要求安排時間，不是請對方預測安裝時間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: reserve 表示保留、預留，可在此代換 allow two hours，保留原本的時間安排意思。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: tolerate 表示容忍；此句不是要求忍受兩小時，而是將兩小時留給安裝及示範。

evidence.quote: Please allow two hours for installation, including a demonstration of the rack’s locking mechanism.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義字須看受詞及補語；allow 加一段時間再接 for，可表示為某用途預留時間。

content.title: From Foundation Workshop to Follow-up Clinic
content.scenario_summary: A staff-learning participant requests course resources and a follow-up clinic place. Website eligibility and submission rules identify her remaining approval form, while feedback requests compared with an exact download inventory reveal missing audio; her use of coworkers' cases and their inability to attend suggest that she represented them at the workshop.

blocks.text: Customer Conversations: Follow-up Clinic

Turn classroom practice into solutions for difficult customer conversations. The June 18 clinic is open to people who completed our foundation workshop within the previous six months. Attendance is included in the foundation workshop fee; there is no additional booking charge.

To confirm a clinic place, send two items: a short reflection describing how you applied a workshop technique, and the clinic approval form signed by your supervisor. We check foundation attendance against our own register. Both documents must reach us by June 5.

The clinic is limited to ten participants so that everyone has time to discuss a real workplace case. Trainer Marcos Vale will lead the practical exercises. Course administrator Tess Ward handles bookings and sends joining instructions once a place is confirmed.
Participant: Noor Chen, Bellmere Services
Workshop attended: April 12
What was useful?
Before the workshop, colleagues from our three service teams each sent me a difficult customer situation. I brought their examples to the practice exercises and noted the trainer's responses.
What additional resources would help?

Please send the presentation slides and a searchable transcript of the workshop. I would also like a separate audio-only recording for my commute, so I can listen without playing a video. The examples are worth hearing again.
What would you like to do next?
I would like to attend the June clinic. The afternoon format suits me better than another full-day course.

documents.title: Your Workshop Resources and Clinic Request

I understand Bellmere could release only you on April 12; the colleagues in those teams had to cover customer calls. We can discuss another date if they are able to attend later.

Best wishes,
Tess

questions.prompt: Why does Northbank Learning limit the clinic to ten participants?

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D
