explanation.summary_zh: 人數限制是為了讓每人都有時間討論真實工作案例。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 網頁直接以 so that 說明限制十人的原因：每位參加者都能討論實際職場案例。這是明示的設計理由，並不是從費用、資格或主管人數推測而來。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 過去六個月內完成基礎課，是參加後續實務研習的資格，並不是報名基礎課本身的資格。十人上限則是為每位實務研習參加者保留案例討論時間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 主管要簽核准表，但文中沒有說主管必須出席，更沒有以主管人數決定上限。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁明確說限制十人是為了讓每人都有時間討論真實工作案例。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中說不額外收費，但沒有把人數限制與某個總費用上限連結。

evidence.quote: The clinic is limited to ten participants so that everyone has time to discuss a real workplace case. Trainer Marcos Vale will lead the practical exercises. Course administrator Tess Ward handles bookings and sends joining instructions once a place is confirmed.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到 why 細節題，找直接表達原因或目的的子句，避免混入其他規則。

questions.prompt: What is Marcos Vale responsible for?

explanation.summary_zh: Marcos Vale 負責帶領實作練習。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 網頁直接說 Trainer Marcos Vale will lead the practical exercises。報名及發送參加須知由 Tess Ward 處理；主管則簽核准表，不能把這些角色混在一起。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 機構會查核出席名冊，但文中沒有把這項工作指定給 Marcos Vale。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁把發送參加須知的工作明確交給課務行政 Tess Ward。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 核准表要由參加者的主管簽署，文中沒有說 Marcos 是參加者的主管。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁直接指派 Marcos Vale 帶領實作練習，與此選項一致。

evidence.quote: The clinic is limited to ten participants so that everyone has time to discuss a real workplace case. Trainer Marcos Vale will lead the practical exercises. Course administrator Tess Ward handles bookings and sends joining instructions once a place is confirmed.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 角色細節題依文中明確分工作答，勿將同一機構的所有工作歸給同一人。

content.title: Furniture for Fairhaven Hall
content.scenario_summary: A community hall coordinates furniture delivery between volunteer induction and a donor reception. The confirmed service adds supplier packaging removal while retaining assembly. Unexpected floor-space flexibility inspires new rental photographs.

blocks.text: Fairhaven Hall: Furniture Delivery Notice
Issued September 3

Our new folding tables and chairs are due on September 14. The supplier, Ellery Furnishings, will unload at the east entrance and assemble the furniture in the main hall. Hall staff will remove the packing materials and take them to the recycling area after the installers leave.

The main hall will be closed to visitors during the work, but the reception office will remain open. Please address questions about building access to facilities coordinator Amir Khan. Questions about the furniture order should go to purchasing officer Beth Lowe.

A confirmed timetable will be posted once Ellery has assigned a crew. Staff should keep the east corridor free of stored boxes on the delivery day. The existing furniture will remain in the smaller meeting room for use by groups based there.
Confirmed Delivery Timetable
Issued September 8 | Work date: September 14
Ellery Furnishings — Fairhaven Hall. Crew leader: Daniel Cho. Amir Khan will meet the crew at the east entrance and remain available for access questions.
Furniture delivery and installation
rows: Unload tables and chairs at east entrance
Check quantities and test folding mechanisms
Amir Khan and Ellery crew leader
Remove packing materials and take them away for recycling

blocks.text: The crew leader will give Amir the signed installation checklist before departure. Any missing items should be listed on that checklist. The hall may reopen at noon after the access route has been checked.
To: Hall events team
From: Louise Grant
Date: September 9
Subject: September activities and new photographs

Our volunteer induction is on September 12, and the donor reception is on September 16. Please send Amir the reception seating figures by September 11. Include helpers who will stay for the meal, but leave out those going home after setup.

I tried a sample table at the supplier's showroom yesterday. Folded against the wall, these tables leave much more open floor space than I had expected. I have booked a photographer for September 18: one picture will show the room arranged for a seated dinner, and the other will show it ready for an exercise class.

The two pictures will replace the exterior photograph in the reply we send to people asking about hiring the hall. Please remove personal belongings from the room before the photographer arrives. Beth has offered to select the table coverings; I will arrange the chairs. We will ask for copies suitable for both printed brochures and e-mail replies.
Louise

questions.prompt: When is the furniture scheduled to be assembled in relation to the two events mentioned by Ms. Grant?

options.label: A
options.text: Before both the volunteer induction and the donor reception.

options.label: B
options.text: After both the volunteer induction and the donor reception.

options.label: C
options.text: After the volunteer induction but before the donor reception.

options.label: D
options.text: After the donor reception but before the volunteer induction.

explanation.summary_zh: 家具組裝安排在志工說明會之後、捐款人餐會之前。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認時程將組裝列在九月十四日；Grant 女士的郵件則提供兩場活動日期：志工說明會九月十二日，捐款人餐會九月十六日。因此組裝位於兩場活動之間。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 九月十四日組裝晚於九月十二日的志工說明會，不能說早於兩場活動。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 九月十四日組裝早於九月十六日的捐款人餐會，不能說晚於兩場活動。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。九月十二日先辦說明會，九月十四日組裝，九月十六日再辦餐會。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件中的說明會早於餐會，且組裝也早於餐會，因此不是餐會之後、說明會之前。

evidence.quote: Work date: September 14
Assemble furniture in main hall
Our volunteer induction is on September 12, and the donor reception is on September 16.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件時間題要把一份文件的工作日期放入另一份文件提供的活動順序中。

questions.prompt: In the notice, the word "address" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: address 在此表示把問題送交或提出給指定的人。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 此句使用 address questions to someone，重點是問題應交給誰，而不是自己回答或解決問題。因此 send 可保留原句指定聯絡對象的意思。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: address questions 有時可以指處理或回答問題，但本句接 to Amir Khan 指定收件對象，因此不是要求讀者回答問題。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。send questions to Amir Khan 保留把出入問題交給指定協調人的意思。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: resolve 表示解決；此處是指示讀者把問題交給協調人，不是要求讀者先解決問題。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: describe 表示描述，未保留將問題交由指定窗口處理的指示；原文的重點是聯絡對象。

evidence.quote: Please address questions about building access to facilities coordinator Amir Khan.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義動詞須連同介系詞與受詞判讀；address questions to someone 與單獨 address a problem 的用法不同。

questions.prompt: Why has Ms. Grant most likely arranged for two photographs of the room?

options.label: A
options.text: To help potential renters judge which activities the hall can accommodate.

options.label: B
options.text: To help current volunteers decide which activities they should organise.

options.label: C
options.text: To teach potential renters how to assemble the hall's furniture.

options.label: D
options.text: To teach current volunteers how to assemble the hall's furniture.

explanation.summary_zh: 她最可能想讓潛在租用者看出場地適合哪些活動。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 兩張照片分別呈現用餐與運動課程的配置，顯示不同用途；而照片將用於回覆詢問租場地的人。將畫面內容與收件對象結合，可推知目的是幫助潛在租用者評估場地是否適用。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。兩種活動配置加上租借詢問的用途，共同支持協助潛在租用者評估場地的動機。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 照片確實呈現活動配置，但指定收件者是詢問租借場地的人，並非讓現有志工決定活動內容。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 收件對象符合，但照片展示完成的用餐與運動配置，沒有呈現家具組裝步驟，因此不支持教學目的。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這同時誤判收件對象與畫面用途；照片是回覆租借詢問用的場地配置照，不是志工組裝教材。

evidence.quote: one picture will show the room arranged for a seated dinner, and the other will show it ready for an exercise class.
The two pictures will replace the exterior photograph in the reply we send to people asking about hiring the hall.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 動機推論可同時檢查提供的內容與預期對象，避免只憑其中一項就猜用途。

questions.prompt: How did Ellery's responsibilities change between the notice and the confirmed timetable?

options.label: A
options.text: It retained packing-material removal and added furniture assembly.

options.label: B
options.text: It gave up packing-material removal but retained furniture assembly.

options.label: C
options.text: It added packing-material removal but gave up furniture assembly.

options.label: D
options.text: It added packing-material removal and retained furniture assembly.

explanation.summary_zh: Ellery 新增了清走包裝材料的責任，原有的家具組裝責任則保留。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 公告中，供應商負責組裝，會館人員清走包裝材料；確認時程則把組裝與清運包裝材料兩項都列給 Ellery 團隊。因此改變的是新增清運責任，而非移除或新增組裝工作。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 原先清運包裝材料屬於會館人員，不是 Ellery 已有的責任；組裝則原本就由 Ellery 負責。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 公告未把清運責任交給 Ellery，因此不能說它放棄該責任；確認時程反而新增這項工作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 新增清運責任這部分正確，但確認時程仍由 Ellery 團隊組裝家具，並未放棄組裝。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。比較兩份文件可見清運由會館移交供應商，而家具組裝一直由供應商負責。

evidence.quote: The supplier, Ellery Furnishings, will unload at the east entrance and assemble the furniture in the main hall.
Hall staff will remove the packing materials and take them to the recycling area after the installers leave.
Assemble furniture in main hall
Remove packing materials and take them away for recycling
Ellery crew

explanation.takeaway_zh: 比較職責變動時，可分別追蹤每一項工作在前後文件的負責人，區分新增、保留與移交。

questions.prompt: Which helpers should be included in the reception seating figures?

options.label: A
options.text: All helpers taking part in setting up the reception.

options.label: B
options.text: Only helpers who are also attending the volunteer induction.

options.label: C
options.text: Helpers who will remain to eat with the guests.

options.label: D
options.text: Helpers who will leave as soon as the room is ready.

explanation.summary_zh: 座位人數應包括會留下來與賓客用餐的協助人員。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 郵件明說要計入留下用餐的 helpers，並排除布置完就回家的人。判斷依據是是否留下用餐，而非是否參與布置或志工說明會。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 並非所有參與布置的人都要計入；布置後離開、不留下用餐者應排除。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件沒有用是否參加志工說明會作為座位統計條件；指定條件是留下用餐。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。remain to eat with the guests 改述 stay for the meal。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 布置完就離開的人正是郵件要求不要計入的協助人員。

evidence.quote: Include helpers who will stay for the meal, but leave out those going home after setup.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 統計人數的細節題要抓住納入條件，不能把參加前置工作等同於參加用餐。

content.title: A Translation Service and Two Projects
content.scenario_summary: A small business translation webpage promises four service features. A food company client values errors caught in a completed menu project despite an email-only wording exchange, then requests joint delivery of a brochure and labels. A later internal memo records staggered delivery under limited translator availability and coordinates printed proofs with an external supplier.

blocks.text: Clearleaf Translation — Small Business Service

Make your product information useful to a new audience. Our translators work with independent manufacturers, shops, and restaurants on brochures, labels, and menus. We accept a limited number of active projects, so please reserve space before sending material.

Every project includes a short telephone conversation with your translator to resolve wording questions. We also check repeated product terms against your approved glossary and send progress messages every two business days. Completed translations are supplied as editable word-processing files.

Request a quotation at clearleaf.example/business. Tell us the languages, approximate word count, and intended publication date. We will confirm availability and a delivery schedule before work begins.
From: Nina Shah <nina.shah@brackenfoods.example>
To: Clearleaf Translation <projects@clearleaf.example>
Date: June 6
Subject: Menu files received; brochure and labels to follow
Hello,

The editable menu files opened correctly, and our product names all matched the glossary. Your progress messages came every two business days. There was no telephone call; we settled the wording questions in five emails, which took most of my afternoon. Still, the translator spotted two measurements that would have confused our customers.

I would like to book our next project with you: a brochure and a set of jar labels, about 4,000 words altogether. I would prefer to receive both parts together by noon on June 18, so our designer can review them in one session. Please confirm what you can accommodate before I send the files.

Regards,
Nina
Bracken Foods — Production Memo
From: Nina Shah | To: Launch team | June 18

Clearleaf had only one translator available for our booking. The brochure translation reached us at 10 A.M. on June 17; the label translations followed at 9 A.M. today. Our designer has now checked both and sent the approved files onward.

Elliot has fitted our order between two other customers’ jobs. He will bring printed proofs to our office at 11 A.M. today for the team to examine. Please check the label text beside an actual jar, particularly near the curved edges.

The finished brochures and labels are due at the packing room at 2 P.M. on June 20. Keep the sample jars in the office until Elliot has collected the approved proofs, then return them to the packing room.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Shah’s email suggest about her attitude toward Clearleaf?

options.label: A
options.text: She considers a telephone conversation essential before placing another order.

options.label: B
options.text: She values careful translation enough to tolerate some inconvenience in communication.

options.label: C
options.text: She believes the service is suitable for menus but not for product packaging.

options.label: D
options.text: She expects future projects to require no review by her own staff.

explanation.summary_zh: 她雖花時間透過郵件釐清問題，仍肯定譯者抓出錯誤並再次委託，可推知願意接受部分溝通不便。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一段描述五封郵件花去大半個下午，隨後提到譯者發現可能誤導顧客的測量數值；下一段又要預訂新案。時間成本、具體價值及再次委託三點合起來，支持她重視細心翻譯而能容忍一些溝通不便。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她沒有把電話交談列為再下單的必要條件，而是已提出預訂新專案的請求。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 溝通花費時間但譯者避免了顧客誤解，她仍想續用服務，支持此態度推論。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她的新案包含罐裝產品標籤，不能推成只信任菜單翻譯而不適合包裝。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她明說希望設計師能在同一次作業檢查兩部分，因此並非預期自己團隊完全不需審閱。

evidence.quote: There was no telephone call; we settled the wording questions in five emails, which took most of my afternoon.
Still, the translator spotted two measurements that would have confused our customers.
I would like to book our next project with you: a brochure and a set of jar labels, about 4,000 words altogether.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 態度推論可由具體代價、具體收益及後續選擇綜合判斷，不能只把單一評語換成近義詞。

questions.prompt: When will the launch team examine the printed proofs?

explanation.summary_zh: 備忘錄日期是六月十八日，today 的上午十一點是查看印刷樣張的時間。
explanation.reasoning_zh: printed proofs 的約定時間是 at 11 A.M. today；A 與 C 都列上午十一點，因此還須用備忘錄日期把 today 定位為六月十八日。上午九點是標籤翻譯送達時刻，六月二十日下午兩點則是印刷成品送達時間。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 上午十一點符合印刷樣張審閱的時刻，但六月十七日是前段提到文宣翻譯送達的日期；備忘錄的 today 指六月十八日。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 六月十八日上午九點是收到標籤翻譯的時間，不是 Elliot 帶來印刷樣張的時間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 備忘錄日期加上 at 11 A.M. today，確定是六月十八日上午十一點。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 六月二十日下午兩點是完成的文宣及標籤送到包裝室的預定時間，晚於樣張審閱。

evidence.quote: From: Nina Shah | To: Launch team | June 18

Clearleaf had only one translator available for our booking. The brochure translation reached us at 10 A.M. on June 17; the label translations followed at 9 A.M. today. Our designer has now checked both and sent the approved files onward.
He will bring printed proofs to our office at 11 A.M. today for the team to examine.
The finished brochures and labels are due at the packing room at 2 P.M. on June 20.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 時間題要區分翻譯檔案、印刷樣張及最終成品等不同階段，並用文件日期解讀 today。

questions.prompt: Who is Elliot most likely?

options.label: A
options.text: A representative of the printing company

options.label: B
options.text: A translator working on the jar labels

options.label: D
options.text: A designer employed by Bracken Foods

explanation.summary_zh: 他把本公司的訂單排入其他客戶工作之間，並帶來印刷樣張，最可能是印刷公司的聯絡人。
explanation.reasoning_zh: other customers’ jobs 顯示 Elliot 為多個客戶安排工作，而不是單純本公司內部成員；他接著帶來 printed proofs，指出服務是印刷製作。兩項線索共同支持印刷公司的代表。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 為多個客戶排單，加上提供印刷樣張，符合印刷服務供應商的聯絡人。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 翻譯工作已交付且交給設計師檢查；Elliot 的後續行動涉及印刷樣張，不是翻譯標籤。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中是 Elliot 安排本公司的訂單並交樣張，並非他向 Bracken 購買食品。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 設計師已在前一段完成檔案檢查；Elliot 又提及其他客戶的工作，較符合外部印刷供應商。

evidence.quote: Our designer has now checked both and sent the approved files onward.
Elliot has fitted our order between two other customers’ jobs.
He will bring printed proofs to our office at 11 A.M. today for the team to examine.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 角色推論可結合「與誰往來」及「交付什麼成果」，避免只依一個職務相關動詞猜職稱。

questions.prompt: Which aspect of Ms. Shah’s menu project differed from the service described on Clearleaf’s website?

options.label: A
options.text: The format of the completed translation files

options.label: B
options.text: The handling of repeated product terms

options.label: D
options.text: The method used to discuss wording questions

explanation.summary_zh: 網站說會以電話討論措辭，但 Shah 女士實際透過郵件處理，沒有電話交談。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 網頁列出四項服務：可編輯檔案、依詞彙表核對、每兩個工作天更新及電話討論。信件證實前三項均符合，只有措辭問題改以五封郵件解決，沒有進行電話交談。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網站說提供可編輯的文書檔案，信件也說收到的 editable menu files 正常開啟，並無差異。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網站說會依核准詞彙表核對，信件也說產品名稱全都符合詞彙表，並無差異。

option_analysis.label: C
